description: This file defines a React hook and context provider for authentication management, including admin role verification via Supabase or mock mode, handling user sessions, sign-in/out, password reset, and Google OAuth integration.

classes.name: AuthContext
classes.description: React context for authentication state and helpers.

methods.name: isNoRowsFoundError
methods.description: Checks if an error from Supabase indicates no rows found.

methods.name: computeIsAdminFromAdminsTable
methods.description: Determines if the current user is an admin by checking the 'public.admins' table.

methods.name: AuthProvider
methods.description: React component providing authentication context, managing user session, admin status, and auth actions.

methods.name: useAuth
methods.description: Custom hook to access authentication context within React components.
